summary: The ternary Goldbach problem: the arXiv abstract says The ternary Goldbach conjecture (or three-prime conjecture) states that every…
body: The arXiv record https://arxiv.org/abs/1501.05438 for "The ternary Goldbach problem" abstracts the work as follows: "The ternary Goldbach conjecture (or three-prime conjecture) states that every odd number greater than 5 can be written as the sum of three primes. The purpose of this book is to give the first proof of the conjecture, in full." This card quotes that abstract. A preprint is the authors' manuscript.
